title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 027
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute brush and palette variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Flat paint brush outline with a square handle and four short bottom bristles
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a flat brush head with visible short bristles.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded or angled brush tools when the square handle and bristle row matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a flat brush block with a centered handle and short bottom bristle marks.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded paint brush outline with a looped handle and square bristle block
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer rounded paint brush with a looped handle shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flat or angled brush icons when the looped handle is the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot curves the handle into a loop above a separate square bristle block.

items.depicts_observation: Angled brush outline with a slanted head band and curved lower bristle edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a brush with a slanted head rather than a flat square bristle block.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the centered flat brush forms when the angled head is the key visual cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tilts the brush head and gives the lower edge a slanted painted curve.

items.depicts_observation: Paint palette outline with three paint dots and a thumb notch cutout
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the classic curved painter palette shape with paint dots.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for swatch or folded palette shapes when the curved thumb notch matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a curved painter palette with three dots and one thumb opening.

items.depicts_observation: Vertical swatch block with two overlapping sample panels and one round mark
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants color selection shown as stacked sample panels instead of a painter palette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the curved palette board when the upright swatch panels are the main cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the palette board with upright overlapping color sample panels.
